verdict.rationale: Deepgram supports prompting, reusable agent configs (passed at call time via UUID), function calling, and mid-call message injection, which together allow injecting per-call context/variables into agent behavior; A/B testing of configs also implies runtime parameterization. However there is no explicit documented mechanism for templated dynamic variables (e.g., {{caller_name}}) or a dedicated per-caller context API akin to other platforms. missing for 10: explicit dynamic variable templating syntax, dedicated per-caller metadata injection API, hands-on example of personalizing a call with caller-specific data.
